## v1.1.0 — 2026-09-29

**Desktop notifications now show who messaged you and what they said, and InstaDesktop keeps itself up to date.**

### ✨ Highlights

- **Sender and message in notifications** — Direct message notifications show the sender's name and the message text instead of a generic "You have a new message".
- **Works in the background** — A hidden, muted inbox detects new messages while you are on Home, Reels or minimized to the tray. It never opens a conversation, so nothing is marked as seen.
- **Automatic updates that work** — InstaDesktop finds new GitHub Releases, verifies the installer's SHA-256, upgrades in place and starts again.

### 🛠️ Improvements

- Follow-up messages in an already unread conversation are notified with the sender's name (Instagram summarizes these as "N new messages").
- Typing indicators no longer turn a new message into a generic notification.
- A message reported by both the main window and the background inbox produces a single notification.
- Notification permission follows the **Desktop notifications** setting for both `instagram.com` and `www.instagram.com`, and is repaired at startup if an older version or a permission reset left it denied.
- Clearer local diagnostics: Windows notification state (disabled for the app, the user or by policy), toast failures and update steps are recorded in the app log. No names or message content are logged.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed: Desktop notifications failed to appear or only showed generic text (known issue in v1.0.0).
- Fixed: The app could close unexpectedly when a notification was clicked, dismissed or expired after the background inbox restarted.
- Fixed: Automatic updates never detected a newer release.
- Fixed: After a silent update the app did not start again.

### 🔄 Updating

Existing users can simply launch InstaDesktop. If an update is available, the app downloads the latest installer from this Release and upgrades automatically.

> **Upgrading from v1.0.0:** the v1.0.0 updater cannot read GitHub Releases, so install this version once manually. Every later version installs automatically.

Manual installation is also available:

1. Download **`InstaDesktop-Setup.exe`** below.
2. Run it; your profile and custom `Assets` are preserved.

### 📦 Downloads

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `InstaDesktop-Setup.exe` | Recommended per-user Windows installer |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for downloaded files |

### ✅ Verification

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime
- Automated: 183 notification and update checks, 258 WebView2 integration checks and offline inbox DOM fixtures
- Checked against a live Messages list: unread and read conversations are recognized

### ⚠️ Known Issues

- When Instagram only shows "N new messages" for a conversation, the notification shows that summary instead of the text.
- Microphone and camera are inaccessible during calls (unchanged from v1.0.0).

### 🔐 Security & privacy

No credentials or profile data are included in release assets. Update downloads use HTTPS from this repository's Releases, and the installer's SHA-256 is verified before execution.
